Class ToIr

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.frontend.ToIr
public final class ToIr extends Object
The explicit IR of a model in the full syntax, as the compiler gives it (clafer -m clafer), and its scopes. The clafers are the Symbols: their UIDs, supers, references, cards, group cards, modifiers and initializers, with the layout, the braces and the defaults gone. The constraints, objectives, assertions, initial values and transitions are resolved by the Resolver, and the scopes are the compiler's (ScopeAnalysis). As in the compiler, the constraints of a reference to a set expression come first in its clafer, a nested assertion is quantified over the instances of its clafer (all this_ : A.b |), and the objectives and assertions are collected in pre-order.

Every rich explicit model is such a model, so it gives its own IR back.
